# PruebaDiagnostica
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>A Memorable Trip · Diagnostic Test</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&family=Caveat:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>

:root{
  --bg:#EDF1F4; --paper:#FFFFFF; --ink:#1C2B3F; --muted:#5B6A7D; --line:#C4CFDA;
  --head:#17335C; --navy:#17335C; --navy-ink:#FFFFFF; --teal:#1F7F76; --teal-2:#3AA89B;
  --coral:#C4532F; --coral-ink:#FFFFFF; --sand:#F7F0E6; --mist:#E2EFEE; --rose:#FBE7E0;
  --pen:#1E4F8F; --ok:#1F7F76; --focus:#3AA89B; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,51,92,.08),0 6px 24px rgba(23,51,92,.06);
  --f-head:"Poppins",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Source Sans 3","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --f-read:"Lora",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-pen:"Caveat","Segoe Print","Comic Sans MS",cursive;
  color-scheme:light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#0D1726; --paper:#142236; --ink:#E4EAF2; --muted:#9DABBD; --line:#33475F;
    --head:#CFE0F6; --navy:#0F2748; --navy-ink:#F2F6FB; --teal:#5CC6B9; --teal-2:#3AA89B;
    --coral:#E0714C; --coral-ink:#1A0F0A; --sand:#1C2B41; --mist:#143236; --rose:#3A231D;
    --pen:#9CC4FF; --ok:#5CC6B9; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0D1726; --paper:#142236; --ink:#E4EAF2; --muted:#9DABBD; --line:#33475F;
  --head:#CFE0F6; --navy:#0F2748; --navy-ink:#F2F6FB; --teal:#5CC6B9; --teal-2:#3AA89B;
  --coral:#E0714C; --coral-ink:#1A0F0A; --sand:#1C2B41; --mist:#143236; --rose:#3A231D;
  --pen:#9CC4FF; --ok:#5CC6B9; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color-scheme:dark;
}
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 120px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--navy)}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--f-head);color:var(--head);margin:0;line-height:1.15}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.1rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:.35em}
h3{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:1.6em 0 .5em}
h4{font-size:1rem;font-weight:600}
p{margin:.4em 0 .8em}
a{color:var(--teal)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:.88rem}
.ico{width:1.1em;height:1.1em;vertical-align:-.18em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}

/* top bar */
.bar{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--navy);color:var(--navy-ink)}
.bar-in{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px 0}
.brand{font-family:var(--f-head);font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.save{margin-left:auto;font-size:.82rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;opacity:.9;white-space:nowrap}
.save .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#8FD6CC}
.save[data-s="saving"] .dot{background:#F2C14E}
.save[data-s="local"] .dot{background:#F2A27E}
.tabs{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 12px 0;scrollbar-width:none}
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tab{appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:600 .9rem var(--f-head);padding:8px 12px 10px;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.78;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.tab:hover{opacity:1}
.tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--bg);color:var(--head);opacity:1}
.tab .sent{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#8FD6CC;display:none}
.tab.is-sent .sent{display:inline-block}

main{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 14px 60px}
.view{display:none}
.view.on{display:block}
fieldset#wb{border:0;margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0;transition:opacity .3s}
fieldset#wb:disabled{opacity:.55}
.loading{max-width:980px;margin:12px auto 0;padding:0 14px}
.loading div{background:var(--mist);color:var(--ink);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.92rem}

/* sheet = page of the workbook */
.sheet{background:var(--paper);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:clamp(18px,4vw,40px);margin:0 0 22px;position:relative}
.kicker{font:700 .78rem var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--teal);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.sess{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 18px;background:var(--mist);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 16px;margin:0 0 22px}
.sess b{font:700 .86rem var(--f-head);color:var(--teal);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sess label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.92rem;margin-left:auto}
.sess input[type=date]{font:inherit;border:0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);padding:2px 4px}
.check-pill{font-size:.85rem;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted)}
.check-pill.ok{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--ok);color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}

.task{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin:22px 0 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:1.02rem}
.task .L{flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--navy);color:var(--navy-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 .85rem var(--f-head)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .task .L{background:#2B4F7E}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .task .L{background:#2B4F7E}
.pts{color:var(--coral);font:700 .82rem var(--f-head);white-space:nowrap}

.mission{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--coral);color:var(--coral-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 22px 7px 7px;margin-bottom:14px}
.mission i{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);color:#C4532F;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal}
.mission b{font:700 1rem var(--f-head)}
.mission span{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.95}

.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.grid3,.grid4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:560px){.grid2,.grid3,.grid4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.box{border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px}
.box h4{margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.box.sand{background:var(--sand);border-color:transparent}
.box.mist{background:var(--mist);border-color:transparent}
.box.rose{background:var(--rose);border-color:transparent}
.tip{border:1.5px dashed var(--teal-2);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin:14px 0;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.95rem}
.tip .ico{color:var(--teal);margin-top:3px}
.strategy{background:var(--navy);color:var(--navy-ink);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;display:flex;gap:16px;margin:18px 0}
.strategy .bub{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-2);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff}
.strategy h4{color:inherit;margin-bottom:4px}
.strategy p{margin:0}
.steps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 18px;margin-top:12px;font:600 .88rem var(--f-head)}
.steps span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.steps em{font-style:normal;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-2);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.8rem}

/* fields: the student's pen */
.ln,.ta,select,.cell-in{font-family:var(--f-pen);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1.25;color:var(--pen);background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);width:100%;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:0}
.ln:focus,.ta:focus,select:focus,.cell-in:focus{outline:none;border-bottom-color:var(--teal-2);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mist) 55%,transparent)}
.ta{resize:vertical;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0 calc(1.75rem - 1px),color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 60%,transparent) calc(1.75rem - 1px) 1.75rem);background-position:0 8px;line-height:1.75rem;min-height:5.5rem}
.ta:focus{border-color:var(--teal-2)}
select{width:auto;min-width:4.5rem;cursor:pointer}
.ln::placeholder,.ta::placeholder{color:var(--muted);opacity:.6}
.fld{display:block;margin:10px 0}
.fld>span{display:block;font-size:.95rem}
.row{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap}
.row>.ln{flex:1;min-width:140px}
.rg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 14px}
.rg.col{flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.opt{display:inline-flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.97rem}
.opt input{width:18px;height:18px;margin:3px 0 0;accent-color:var(--teal);flex:none}
.mc .opt b{color:var(--head)}
.scale .opt{gap:4px}

table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;font-size:.95rem}
.tw{overflow-x:auto;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin:10px 0}
th{background:var(--mist);font:600 .86rem var(--f-head);color:var(--head);text-align:left;padding:10px 12px}
td{padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
td .ln{font-size:1.25rem}
td.c{text-align:center}

/* hero */
.hero{border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy);color:var(--navy-ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:22px}
.hero .ph{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/8;background:#173459 center/cover}
.hero .ph span{position:absolute;left:20px;top:18px;background:#fff;color:#17335C;font:700 .75rem var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.1em;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px}
.hero .tx{padding:clamp(20px,4vw,40px)}
.hero .tx small{font:600 .72rem var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8FD6CC}
.hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,8vw,4.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:.12em 0 .05em}
.hero .sub{font:italic 1.45rem var(--f-read);margin:0 0 16px;color:#E6EEF8}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
.chip{font:600 .85rem var(--f-head);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid #C9D6E6}
.chip.t{background:var(--teal-2);border-color:var(--teal-2);color:#fff}
.hero .au{font-size:.92rem;color:#D5E0EE}

/* vocab cards */
.vocab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:760px){.vocab{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:460px){.vocab{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.vc{background:var(--sand);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;border:2px solid transparent}
.vc input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.vc b{font:700 1.15rem var(--f-head);color:var(--head);display:block}
.vc small{color:var(--muted);display:block}
.vc i{font-family:var(--f-read);font-size:.95rem;display:block;margin-top:4px}
.vc:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--coral);border-radius:46% 54% 50% 50% / 18% 22% 20% 24%}
.vc:has(input:checked)::after{content:"I know it";position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;font:600 1.1rem var(--f-pen);color:var(--coral)}
.vc:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--focus)}

/* reading */
.read{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 230px;gap:26px}
@media (max-width:760px){.read{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.text p{font-family:var(--f-read);font-size:1.12rem;line-height:1.85;margin:0 0 1em}
.pn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;font:700 .75rem var(--f-head);margin-right:6px;vertical-align:2px}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .pn{background:#1F7F76}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .pn{background:#1F7F76}
.side{border-left:1.5px solid var(--line);padding-left:18px}
@media (max-width:760px){.side{border-left:0;padding-left:0}}
.side figure{margin:0 0 14px}
figure img{border-radius:12px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:cover}
figcaption{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin:10px 0}
@media (max-width:620px){.photos{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.wide{border-radius:14px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/5;object-fit:cover;margin:6px 0 4px}

/* clue cards */
.clue{background:var(--sand);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px}
.clue .n{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:700 1rem var(--f-head);color:var(--coral)}
.clue .n small{color:var(--muted);font:500 .8rem var(--f-body)}
.clue q{font-family:var(--f-read);display:block;margin:4px 0 6px;quotes:"“" "”"}
.clue .hint{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}

.levels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
@media (max-width:620px){.levels{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.lvl{border-radius:14px;padding:14px;text-align:center;background:var(--sand)}
.lvl b{display:block;font:700 1rem var(--f-head);color:var(--head)}
.lvl.on{background:var(--teal-2);color:#fff}
.lvl.on b{color:#fff}
.badges{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:10px}
@media (max-width:620px){.badges{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.badge{text-align:center;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line)}
.badge .b{width:58px;height:58px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:1.5rem}
.badge.won{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--coral)}
.badge.won .b{background:var(--coral);border:0;color:#fff}
.badge small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}

.cases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
@media (max-width:620px){.cases{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.case{background:var(--sand);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.case img{aspect-ratio:16/7;object-fit:cover;width:100%}
.case div{padding:12px 16px}
.case ul{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:18px;font-size:.95rem}

.prog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(15,1fr);gap:3px;margin:8px 0 2px}
.prog i{height:18px;border-radius:4px;border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.prog i.f{background:var(--teal-2);border-color:var(--teal-2)}

.cert{border:3px double var(--coral);border-radius:16px;padding:28px;text-align:center;background:var(--sand)}
.cert .nm{font:600 2.2rem var(--f-pen);color:var(--pen);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);display:inline-block;min-width:60%;margin:6px 0 10px}
.cert h2{font-size:2rem}

/* send panel: luggage tag */
.send{border:2px solid var(--navy);border-radius:18px;background:var(--paper);padding:20px 22px;margin:8px 0 26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .send{border-color:#3C6396}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .send{border-color:#3C6396}
.send h3{margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.send .meter{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--mist);overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0 6px;max-width:420px}
.send .meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--teal-2);width:0;transition:width .3s}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 18px;font:600 .95rem var(--f-head);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}
.btn.pri{background:var(--coral);color:#fff}
.btn.pri:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
.btn.sec{background:transparent;color:var(--head);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
.state{font-size:.93rem;margin-top:10px}
.state.warn{color:var(--coral);font-weight:600}
.stamp{position:absolute;right:18px;top:16px;transform:rotate(-9deg);border:3px solid var(--coral);color:var(--coral);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 12px;font:800 .95rem var(--f-head);letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:center;line-height:1.1;opacity:.9;pointer-events:none;background:var(--paper)}
.stamp small{display:block;font:600 .72rem var(--f-body);letter-spacing:0}
.stamp.pop{animation:pop .55s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:rotate(-9deg) scale(2.2);opacity:0}100%{transform:rotate(-9deg) scale(1);opacity:.9}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.stamp.pop{animation:none}}
@media (max-width:560px){.stamp{position:static;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px}}
.fb{margin-top:16px;background:var(--mist);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px}
.fb b{font-family:var(--f-head);color:var(--head)}
.fb p{white-space:pre-wrap;margin:.3em 0 0}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-size:.95rem;z-index:50;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);max-width:92vw;display:none}
.toast.on{display:block}

/* teacher */
.tlist td{cursor:pointer}
.tlist tr:hover td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mist) 50%,transparent)}
.cellst{font-size:.85rem;white-space:nowrap}
.cellst.sent{color:var(--teal);font-weight:600}
.cellst.rev{color:var(--coral);font-weight:700}
.ans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:0;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0}
.ans div{padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.93rem}
.ans div:nth-child(-n+2){border-top:0}
.ans .q{background:var(--sand);color:var(--muted)}
.ans .a{white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--pen);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:560px){.ans{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ans .a{border-top:0}}
.tin{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;width:100%}
textarea.tin{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}
.subtabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:12px 0}
.subtabs button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font:600 .85rem var(--f-head);cursor:pointer}
.subtabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.credits{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
@media print{.bar,.send,.toast,.loading{display:none}.view{display:block}.sheet{box-shadow:none;break-inside:avoid-page}}

.es{display:block;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;font-style:italic}
.item{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0}
.item:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.item .stem{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;gap:10px}
.item .stem .no{flex:none;font:700 .85rem var(--f-head);color:var(--coral);min-width:2.2em}
.item .quote{font-family:var(--f-read);background:var(--sand);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;margin:0 0 8px}
.part{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.part .pts{font-size:.9rem}
.final{border:2px solid var(--navy);border-radius:18px;background:var(--paper);padding:22px;margin-bottom:26px}
.done{text-align:center;padding:40px 20px}
.done .stamp{position:static;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:1.3rem;padding:10px 18px}
.bar-in{padding-bottom:10px}
.stickyprog{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + var(--barh,44px));z-index:15;background:var(--bg);padding:8px 0 10px;margin:-6px 0 12px}
.stickyprog .meter{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--mist);overflow:hidden}
.stickyprog .meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--teal-2);width:0;transition:width .3s}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
@media (max-width:700px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kpi{background:var(--sand);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.kpi b{display:block;font:700 1.7rem var(--f-head);color:var(--head)}
.kpi span{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.sbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(120px,1.2fr) 3fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:8px 0;font-size:.93rem}
.sbar .tr{height:14px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--mist);overflow:hidden}
.sbar .tr i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px}
.lo{background:var(--coral)} .mid{background:#E0A43A} .hi{background:var(--teal-2)}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.pill.b0{background:var(--rose);color:var(--coral)} .pill.b1{background:#FBEFD5;color:#8A5A00} .pill.b2{background:var(--mist);color:var(--teal)} .pill.b3{background:var(--teal-2);color:#fff}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .pill.b1{background:#3B2F14;color:#F2C877}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .pill.b1{background:#3B2F14;color:#F2C877}
.ok{color:var(--teal);font-weight:700} .bad{color:var(--coral);font-weight:700}
.reco{border-left:4px solid var(--coral);padding:6px 12px;margin:8px 0;background:var(--rose);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;font-size:.95rem}
.reco.good{border-color:var(--teal-2);background:var(--mist)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="bar">
  <div class="bar-in">
    <div class="brand">A MEMORABLE TRIP · DIAGNOSTIC</div>
    <div class="save" id="save" data-s="init" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span class="dot"></span><span id="saveTx">Cargando…</span></div>
  </div>
  <nav class="tabs" id="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Secciones" hidden>
    <button class="tab" role="tab" data-v="prueba" id="t-prueba" aria-selected="true">Prueba</button>
    <button class="tab" role="tab" data-v="resultados" id="t-resultados" aria-selected="false">Resultados (docente)</button>
  </nav>
</header>
<div class="loading" id="loading"><div>Abriendo la prueba… En unos segundos podrás responder.</div></div>
<main>
  <section class="view on" id="v-prueba"><fieldset id="wb" disabled></fieldset></section>
  <section class="view" id="v-resultados"></section>
</main>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<script>
const IMG = {"tayrona": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "sunset": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
(function(){
"use strict";
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s), $$=(s,r=document)=>Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
const esc=s=>String(s??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const ICO={send:'<path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/><path d="M22 2 11 13"/>',down:'<path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5M12 15V3"/>',search:'<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/>',bulb:'<path d="M9 18h6M10 22h4"/><path d="M15.09 14c.18-.98.65-1.74 1.41-2.5A4.65 4.65 0 0 0 18 8 6 6 0 0 0 6 8c0 1 .23 2.23 1.5 3.5A4.61 4.61 0 0 1 8.91 14"/>',check:'<path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/>'};
const ic=n=>`<svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${ICO[n]}</svg>`;

/* ---------- items (no answer key here: it lives in the teacher-only data) ---------- */
const SKILLS={vocab:"Vocabulary",main:"Main idea",specific:"Specific information",context:"Context clues",sequence:"Order of events",infer:"Inferences",grammar:"Simple Past",writing:"Writing"};
const PART={vocab:"Vocabulary",main:"Reading",specific:"Reading",context:"Reading",sequence:"Reading",infer:"Reading",grammar:"Grammar",writing:"Writing"};
const ITEMS=[
 {id:"v1",sk:"vocab",stem:"You put your money and cards in your ___.",o:["suitcase","wallet","map","boat"]},
 {id:"v2",sk:"vocab",stem:"A place with a lot of sand next to the sea: ___.",o:["mountain","island","beach","river"]},
 {id:"v3",sk:"vocab",stem:"I couldn’t sleep the night before my first flight. I was very ___.",o:["nervous","tired","bored","hungry"]},
 {id:"v4",sk:"vocab",stem:"We walked for six hours in the mountains. At night we were very ___.",o:["excited","tired","worried","late"]},
 {id:"v5",sk:"vocab",stem:"To go from Santa Marta to Bogotá in one hour, you take a ___.",o:["bus","boat","plane","bicycle"]},
 {id:"v6",sk:"vocab",stem:"At the hotel reception, the receptionist asks for your ___.",o:["backpack","waterfall","sunglasses","ID card"]},
 {id:"v7",sk:"vocab",stem:"Water falls from a high rock. It is a ___.",o:["waterfall","lake","pool","beach"]},
 {id:"v8",sk:"vocab",stem:"We ___ a lot of photos of the old streets.",o:["made","did","took","gave"]},
 {id:"r1",sk:"main",stem:"What is the text mainly about?",o:["How to rent a hammock in Tayrona.","The history of Tayrona National Park.","Why the park entrance is slow.","Two siblings’ weekend trip to Tayrona, a small problem and how it ended."]},
 {id:"r2",sk:"main",stem:"Choose the best title for the text.",o:["Lost in the Jungle","Sun, Sea and Lost Sunglasses","My Nursing Exams","A Long Bus Trip to Bogotá"]},
 {id:"r3",sk:"specific",stem:"Who traveled to Tayrona?",o:["Mateo alone","Mateo and his grandmother","Mateo and a classmate","Mateo and his sister"]},
 {id:"r4",sk:"specific",stem:"When did they go?",o:["Last October","Last December","Last weekend","In January"]},
 {id:"r5",sk:"specific",stem:"How did they travel from Santa Marta to the park?",o:["By car","By plane","By bus","By boat"]},
 {id:"r6",sk:"specific",stem:"Where did they sleep?",o:["In a hotel","In a tent","In hammocks at a campsite","At their grandmother’s house"]},
 {id:"r7",sk:"context",q:"“The path was <b>steep</b> in some parts, so we stopped many times to rest.” (¶2)",stem:"<b>Steep</b> means…",o:["flat and easy","going up a lot; difficult to walk","wet and muddy","very short"]},
 {id:"r8",sk:"context",q:"“She was <b>annoyed</b> because they were a gift from our grandmother.” (¶4)",stem:"<b>Annoyed</b> means…",o:["very happy","sleepy","a little angry","surprised in a good way"]},
 {id:"r9",sk:"context",q:"“We didn’t have a tent, so we <b>rented</b> hammocks.” (¶3)",stem:"<b>Rented</b> means…",o:["paid money to use them for a short time","bought them forever","made them","lost them"]},
 {id:"r10",sk:"sequence",stem:"What did they do right after waiting at the park entrance?",o:["They took a bus.","They swam at the beach.","They rented hammocks.","They walked for two hours to Cabo San Juan."]},
 {id:"r11",sk:"infer",stem:"How did Mateo and Laura probably feel in the line at the entrance?",o:["Impatient and hot","Cold and wet","Scared of the animals","Sad because of their exams"]},
 {id:"r12",sk:"infer",stem:"Why will they bring more sunscreen next time?",o:["Sunscreen is cheap in Tayrona.","They got sunburned on this trip.","Their grandmother told them.","The park asks for it at the entrance."]},
 {id:"g1",sk:"grammar",stem:"Yesterday I ___ my grandmother.",o:["visit","visiting","visits","visited"]},
 {id:"g2",sk:"grammar",stem:"Last year we ___ to Cartagena.",o:["go","goes","went","goed"]},
 {id:"g3",sk:"grammar",stem:"She ___ the museum because it was closed.",o:["didn’t visit","didn’t visited","not visited","doesn’t visited"]},
 {id:"g4",sk:"grammar",stem:"“___ you travel by bus?” “Yes, I did.”",o:["Do","Did","Were","Are"]},
 {id:"g5",sk:"grammar",stem:"The water ___ very cold.",o:["were","be","been","was"]},
 {id:"g6",sk:"grammar",stem:"My friends ___ tired after the hike.",o:["was","is","were","be"]},
 {id:"g7",sk:"grammar",stem:"Where did you ___ last weekend?",o:["stayed","staying","stays","stay"]},
 {id:"g8",sk:"grammar",stem:"We ___ English at the university last semester. (study)",o:["studyed","studied","studdied","studys"]},
 {id:"g9",sk:"grammar",stem:"Choose the correct sentence.",o:["He didn’t found his wallet.","He not find his wallet.","He didn’t find his wallet.","He don’t find his wallet."]},
 {id:"g10",sk:"grammar",stem:"We arrived at the hotel two hours ___.",o:["ago","last","yesterday","before now"]}
];
const RUB=[["w1","Uses the Simple Past (regular, irregular, was/were)",3],["w2","Content: where, who, what happened, a feeling",2],["w3","Travel vocabulary",1]];
const WMAX=6;
const META=[
 {id:"m0",t:"radio",q:"Have you ever traveled to another city in Colombia?",es:"¿Has viajado a otra ciudad de Colombia?",o:["Yes","No"]},
 {id:"m1",t:"radio",q:"How do you feel when you read in English? (1 = very insecure · 5 = very confident)",es:"¿Cómo te sientes cuando lees en inglés?",o:["1","2","3","4","5"]},
 {id:"m2",t:"check",q:"When I find a word I don’t know, I usually…",es:"Cuando encuentro una palabra que no conozco, normalmente… (puedes marcar varias)",o:["translate it with a dictionary or translator","try to guess it from the words around it","skip it and continue reading","ask a classmate or the teacher","stop reading"]},
 {id:"m3",t:"radio",q:"Before I read, I look at the title and the pictures to imagine the topic.",es:"Antes de leer, miro el título y las imágenes para imaginar el tema.",o:["Always","Sometimes","Never"]},
 {id:"m4",t:"radio",q:"When I need one specific piece of information (a date, a name), I…",es:"Cuando necesito un dato específico (una fecha, un nombre)…",o:["read every word from the beginning","move my eyes quickly to find it","don’t know what to do"]},
 {id:"m5",t:"radio",q:"I read a text more than once to understand it better.",es:"Leo un texto más de una vez para entenderlo mejor.",o:["Always","Sometimes","Never"]},
 {id:"m6",t:"radio",q:"After reading, I think about what I understood and what was difficult.",es:"Después de leer, pienso en lo que entendí y en lo que fue difícil.",o:["Always","Sometimes","Never"]},
 {id:"m7",t:"radio",q:"How often do you read in English outside class?",es:"¿Con qué frecuencia lees en inglés fuera de clase?",o:["Never","A few times a month","Every week","Every day"]},
 {id:"m8",t:"check",q:"Which apps or games have you used to learn English?",es:"¿Qué aplicaciones o juegos has usado para aprender inglés?",o:["Kahoot / Quizizz","Wordwall","Duolingo","Google Forms quizzes","None"]},
 {id:"m9",t:"radio",q:"In English class, I prefer to work…",es:"En la clase de inglés prefiero trabajar…",o:["alone","with a partner","in groups"]}
];
const TEXT=[
 "Last October, my sister Laura and I visited Tayrona National Park. My name is Mateo, and I am a second-semester Nursing student. We wanted a quiet weekend after our midterm exams.",
 "We took a bus from Santa Marta early on Saturday. The trip was only one hour, but the line at the park entrance was very long. We waited for forty minutes in the sun. Then we walked for two hours to Cabo San Juan. The path was steep in some parts, so we stopped many times to rest.",
 "We stayed at a small campsite near the beach. We didn’t have a tent, so we rented hammocks. In the afternoon, we swam and ate fried fish with patacones. At night, the sky was full of stars.",
 "On Sunday morning, Laura couldn’t find her sunglasses. She was annoyed because they were a gift from our grandmother. We looked everywhere in the campsite, and finally a little boy found them under a hammock. Laura gave him a mango to say thank you.",
 "We returned home tired and sunburned, but happy. Next time, we will bring more sunscreen!"
];
const ALLKEYS=[...["p.name","p.code","p.program","p.group"],...ITEMS.map(i=>i.id),"w",...META.flatMap(m=>m.t==="check"?m.o.map((_,j)=>m.id+"_"+j):[m.id])];
const REQUIRED=[...ITEMS.map(i=>i.id),"w"];
const L=i=>String.fromCharCode(97+i);

/* ---------- render test ---------- */
function mcItem(it,n){return `<div class="item"><div class="stem"><span class="no">${n}.</span><span>${it.stem}</span></div>${it.q?`<p class="quote">${it.q}</p>`:""}<div class="rg col mc" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Question ${n}">${it.o.map((o,i)=>`<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="${it.id}" value="${L(i)}" data-k="${it.id}"><span><b>${L(i)})</b> ${o}</span></label>`).join("")}</div></div>`}
function renderTest(){
 let n=0;
 const part=(sk)=>ITEMS.filter(i=>PART[i.sk]===sk).map(it=>mcItem(it,++n)).join("");
 $("#wb").innerHTML=`
 <div class="hero">
  <div class="ph" style="background-image:url('${IMG.tayrona||""}');aspect-ratio:16/6" role="img" aria-label="A path by the sea in Tayrona National Park"><span>UNIVERSIDAD DEL MAGDALENA</span></div>
  <div class="tx">
   <small>ENGLISH LEVEL II – A2 · BEFORE THE UNIT</small>
   <h1 style="font-size:clamp(2rem,6vw,3.2rem)">DIAGNOSTIC TEST</h1>
   <p class="sub">A Memorable Trip · Talking About Past Experiences</p>
   <div class="au">This is not an exam with a grade. It helps your teacher know where you are before we start. · <i>Esta prueba no tiene nota: sirve para que tu docente sepa desde dónde empiezas.</i></div>
  </div>
 </div>
 <div class="stickyprog"><div class="row small" style="justify-content:space-between"><span id="progTx">0 of ${REQUIRED.length} answered</span><span class="muted">≈ 40 min</span></div><div class="meter"><i id="progBar"></i></div></div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <h2>Before you start</h2>
  <div class="box rose small"><b>Instrucciones:</b> responde solo, sin diccionario ni traductor. Si no sabes una respuesta, elige la que te parezca más lógica: no pasa nada si te equivocas. Tus respuestas se guardan solas en este navegador; al final pulsa <b>“Descargar copia”</b> y entrégasela a tu docente.</div>
  <div class="grid2" style="margin-top:14px">
   <label class="fld"><span>Full name <span class="es">Nombre completo</span></span><input class="ln" type="text" data-k="p.name" autocomplete="off"></label>
   <label class="fld"><span>Student code <span class="es">Código</span></span><input class="ln" type="text" data-k="p.code" autocomplete="off"></label>
   <label class="fld"><span>Program <span class="es">Programa</span></span><input class="ln" type="text" data-k="p.program" autocomplete="off"></label>
   <label class="fld"><span>Group <span class="es">Grupo</span></span><input class="ln" type="text" data-k="p.group" placeholder="Inglés II – 54" autocomplete="off"></label>
  </div>
 </div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <div class="part"><div class="kicker">Part 1</div><span class="pts">8 points</span></div>
  <h2>Travel vocabulary</h2>
  <p class="muted">Choose the best word. <span class="es">Elige la palabra correcta.</span></p>
  ${part("Vocabulary")}
 </div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <div class="part"><div class="kicker">Part 2</div><span class="pts">12 points</span></div>
  <h2>Reading</h2>
  <p class="muted">Read the text. Then answer the questions. You can go back to the text. <span class="es">Lee el texto y responde. Puedes volver al texto las veces que quieras.</span></p>
  <div class="read" style="margin-top:12px">
   <div class="text"><h3 style="margin-top:0;font-family:var(--f-head)">A Weekend in Tayrona</h3>${TEXT.map((p,i)=>`<p><span class="pn">${i+1}</span>${p}</p>`).join("")}<p class="small muted">(≈ 210 words)</p></div>
   <aside class="side">${`<figure><img src="${IMG.tayrona||""}" alt="Path to the beach in Tayrona"><figcaption>Tayrona National Park</figcaption></figure>`}</aside>
  </div>
  ${part("Reading")}
 </div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <div class="part"><div class="kicker">Part 3</div><span class="pts">10 points</span></div>
  <h2>Grammar: talking about the past</h2>
  <p class="muted">Choose the correct option. <span class="es">Elige la opción correcta.</span></p>
  ${part("Grammar")}
 </div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <div class="part"><div class="kicker">Part 4</div><span class="pts">6 points</span></div>
  <h2>Writing</h2>
  <p><b>Write 4–6 sentences about a trip you took or a special day you remember.</b> Say where you went, who you went with, what you did and how you felt.</p>
  <p class="es">Escribe de 4 a 6 oraciones sobre un viaje o un día especial que recuerdes. Escribe en inglés lo mejor que puedas, aunque cometas errores.</p>
  <textarea class="ta" rows="8" data-k="w" aria-label="Writing"></textarea>
  <p class="small muted" id="wc">0 words</p>
 </div>

 <div class="sheet">
  <div class="part"><div class="kicker">Part 5 · Not scored</div><span class="pts" style="color:var(--teal)">No points</span></div>
  <h2>How I read and learn</h2>
  <p class="muted">There are no right or wrong answers. Be honest. <span class="es">No hay respuestas correctas ni incorrectas. Responde con sinceridad.</span></p>
  ${META.map((m,i)=>`<div class="item"><div class="stem"><span class="no">${i+1}.</span><span>${m.q}<span class="es">${m.es}</span></span></div><div class="rg ${m.o.length>3&&m.t!=="radio"?"col":""}">${m.o.map((o,j)=>m.t==="check"?`<label class="opt"><input type="checkbox" data-k="${m.id}_${j}"><span>${o}</span></label>`:`<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="${m.id}" value="${esc(o)}" data-k="${m.id}"><span>${o}</span></label>`).join("")}</div></div>`).join("")}
 </div>

 <div class="final" id="final"></div>
 <p class="credits" style="padding:0 6px">Photo: Cabo San Juan de Guía, Tayrona — Pablo Andrés Ortega Chávez, GFDL 1.2, Wikimedia Commons. Diagnostic test for the unit <i>A Memorable Trip</i> · Universidad del Magdalena.</p>`;
}

/* ---------- state ---------- */
const S={a:{},updatedAt:0,startedAt:null,uid:null,db:null,user:null,dl:null,cloud:false,ready:false,sent:null,isTeacher:false,writing:false,pending:false};
const lsKey=()=>"amt-diag-v1-"+(S.uid||"local");
function setEl(el,v){if(el.type==="radio")el.checked=(v!==undefined&&el.value===v);else if(el.type==="checkbox")el.checked=!!v;else el.value=v??""}
function applyAll(){$$("#wb [data-k]").forEach(el=>setEl(el,S.a[el.dataset.k]));derived()}
function onField(e){
 const el=e.target;if(!el.dataset||!el.dataset.k||!S.ready||S.sent)return;
 const k=el.dataset.k;let v;
 if(el.type==="radio"){if(!el.checked)return;v=el.value}else if(el.type==="checkbox")v=el.checked;else v=el.value;
 if(v===""||v===false)delete S.a[k];else S.a[k]=v;
 if(!S.startedAt)S.startedAt=Date.now();
 S.updatedAt=Date.now();schedule();derived();
}
let tmr;
function saveState(s,tx){$("#save").dataset.s=s;$("#saveTx").textContent=tx}
function schedule(){saveState("saving","Guardando…");clearTimeout(tmr);tmr=setTimeout(flush,900)}
async function flush(){
 const body={answers:S.a,updatedAt:S.updatedAt,startedAt:S.startedAt};
 try{localStorage.setItem(lsKey(),JSON.stringify(body))}catch(e){}
 if(!(S.db&&S.uid&&S.cloud)){saveState("local","Guardado en este navegador");return}
 if(S.writing){S.pending=true;return}
 S.writing=true;
 try{await S.db.doc("data/users/"+S.uid+"/diagdraft").set(body);saveState("ok","Guardado en tu cuenta")}
 catch(e){if(!(e&&e.code==="unavailable"))S.cloud=false;saveState("local","Guardado en este navegador")}
 finally{S.writing=false;if(S.pending){S.pending=false;flush()}}
}
const answered=()=>REQUIRED.filter(k=>S.a[k]!==undefined&&String(S.a[k]).trim()!=="").length;
const wcount=t=>(t||"").trim()?(t||"").trim().split(/\s+/).length:0;
function derived(){
 const n=answered();
 const pt=$("#progTx");if(pt)pt.textContent=`${n} of ${REQUIRED.length} answered`;
 const pb=$("#progBar");if(pb)pb.style.width=Math.round(n/REQUIRED.length*100)+"%";
 const w=$("#wc");if(w)w.textContent=wcount(S.a.w)+" words";
 renderFinal();
}
const canSend=()=>!!(S.db&&S.uid&&S.cloud);
function renderFinal(){
 const f=$("#final");if(!f)return;
 const n=answered(),miss=REQUIRED.length-n;
 const msg=`Respondiste <b>${n}</b> de ${REQUIRED.length} preguntas${miss?` · te faltan <b>${miss}</b>. Revisa si quieres intentar las que faltan antes de descargar.`:". ¡Muy bien!"}`;
 if(f.dataset.built){f.querySelector("[data-cnt]").innerHTML=msg;f.querySelector("[data-nm]").hidden=!!S.a["p.name"];return}
 f.dataset.built="1";
 f.innerHTML=`<h3 style="margin-top:0">${ic("down")} Download your test · Descargar la prueba</h3>
 <p class="small" data-cnt>${msg}</p>
 <p class="state warn" data-nm ${S.a["p.name"]?"hidden":""}>Escribe tu nombre completo al inicio para que aparezca en la copia.</p>
 <p class="small muted">Cuando termines, descarga la copia y entrégasela a tu docente (por correo o por la plataforma de la clase).</p>
 <div class="btns"><button class="btn pri" type="button" id="dlBtn">${ic("down")} Descargar copia</button></div>`;
 $("#dlBtn").onclick=downloadCopy;
}
async function sendTest(){
 const miss=REQUIRED.length-answered();
 if(miss&&!confirm(`Te faltan ${miss} preguntas. ¿Quieres enviar la prueba de todas formas? Después no podrás cambiarla.`))return;
 if(!miss&&!confirm("¿Enviar tu prueba? Después no podrás cambiar tus respuestas."))return;
 const b=$("#sendBtn");b.disabled=true;b.textContent="Enviando…";
 const answers={};ALLKEYS.forEach(k=>{if(!k.startsWith("p.")&&S.a[k]!==undefined)answers[k]=S.a[k]});
 const now=Date.now();
 const body={profile:{name:S.a["p.name"]||"",code:S.a["p.code"]||"",program:S.a["p.program"]||"",group:S.a["p.group"]||""},answers,startedAt:S.startedAt||now,sentAt:now,minutes:Math.max(1,Math.round((now-(S.startedAt||now))/60000)),version:1};
 try{await S.db.doc("responses/"+S.uid).set(body);S.sent=body;showDone(true)}
 catch(e){toast(e&&e.code==="unavailable"?"No hubo conexión. Intenta de nuevo en un momento.":"No se pudo enviar desde esta cuenta. Avísale a tu docente.");renderFinal()}
}
function showDone(pop){
 $("#wb").innerHTML=`<div class="sheet done"><div class="stamp ${pop?"pop":""}">ENVIADA<small>${esc(new Date(S.sent.sentAt).toLocaleString("es-CO",{day:"numeric",month:"long",hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit"}))}</small></div>
 <h2>Thank you, ${esc((S.sent.profile&&S.sent.profile.name||"").split(" ")[0]||"traveler")}!</h2>
 <p>Your teacher received your diagnostic test. Now you are ready to start <b>A Memorable Trip</b>.</p>
 <p class="es">Tu docente ya recibió tu prueba. Con tus resultados va a preparar las sesiones de la cartilla. No necesitas hacer nada más aquí.</p></div>`;
 $("#wb").disabled=false;
}
function plainCopy(){
 const lines=["A Memorable Trip · Diagnostic test","Nombre: "+(S.a["p.name"]||"—"),"Código: "+(S.a["p.code"]||"—")+" · Grupo: "+(S.a["p.group"]||"—"),""];
 ITEMS.forEach((it,i)=>{const v=S.a[it.id];lines.push((i+1)+". "+(v?v+") "+it.o[v.charCodeAt(0)-97]:"—"))});
 lines.push("","Writing:",S.a.w||"—","");
 META.forEach((m,i)=>{const v=m.t==="check"?m.o.filter((_,j)=>S.a[m.id+"_"+j]).join("; "):S.a[m.id];lines.push("P5."+(i+1)+" "+(v||"—"))});
 return lines.join("\n");
}
function copyHTML(){
 const row=(q,v)=>`<tr><td>${q}</td><td>${esc(v||"—")}</td></tr>`;
 const items=ITEMS.map((it,i)=>{const v=S.a[it.id];return row((i+1)+". "+(it.q?it.q.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,"")+" — ":"")+it.stem.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,""),v?v+") "+it.o[v.charCodeAt(0)-97]:"")}).join("");
 const meta=META.map((m,i)=>row("P5."+(i+1)+" "+m.q,m.t==="check"?m.o.filter((_,j)=>S.a[m.id+"_"+j]).join("; "):S.a[m.id])).join("");
 const now=Date.now(),mins=S.startedAt?Math.max(1,Math.round((now-S.startedAt)/60000)):"—";
 return `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Prueba diagnóstica · ${esc(S.a["p.name"]||"Estudiante")}</title><style>body{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:860px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 16px;color:#1C2B3F}h1{color:#17335C;margin-bottom:4px}h2{color:#17335C;margin-top:28px}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}td{border-bottom:1px solid #ccd;padding:6px 8px;vertical-align:top}td:first-child{color:#5B6A7D;width:60%}.w{white-space:pre-wrap;background:#F7F0E6;padding:12px;border-radius:8px}</style></head><body><h1>A Memorable Trip · Diagnostic Test</h1><p><b>${esc(S.a["p.name"]||"—")}</b> · Código: ${esc(S.a["p.code"]||"—")} · Programa: ${esc(S.a["p.program"]||"—")} · Grupo: ${esc(S.a["p.group"]||"—")}<br>Descargada: ${esc(new Date(now).toLocaleString("es-CO"))} · Tiempo aproximado: ${mins} min · Respondidas: ${answered()} de ${REQUIRED.length}</p><h2>Parts 1–3 · Vocabulary, Reading, Grammar</h2><table>${items}</table><h2>Part 4 · Writing (${wcount(S.a.w)} words)</h2><div class="w">${esc(S.a.w||"—")}</div><h2>Part 5 · How I read and learn</h2><table>${meta}</table></body></html>`;
}
async function downloadCopy(){
 const filename="Diagnostico_"+(S.a["p.name"]||"estudiante").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").replace(/[^\w]+/g,"_")+".html";
 const blob=new Blob([copyHTML()],{type:"text/html"});
 if(S.dl){try{await S.dl.save({filename,data:blob});return}catch(e){if(!(e&&e.code==="unavailable"))return}}
 try{const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement("a");a.href=u;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),4000);toast("Copia descargada. Entrégasela a tu docente.")}
 catch(e){toast("No se pudo descargar en este navegador. Intenta desde otro navegador.")}
}
let tt;function toast(m){const t=$("#toast");t.textContent=m;t.classList.add("on");clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("on"),4200)}

/* ---------- teacher results ---------- */
const T={resp:[],grades:{},key:null,keyLoaded:false,names:{},sel:null,group:""};
function scoreOf(r){
 const k=T.key||{};const a=(r&&r.answers)||{};const by={};Object.keys(SKILLS).forEach(s=>by[s]={c:0,n:0});
 ITEMS.forEach(it=>{by[it.sk].n++;if(k[it.id]&&a[it.id]===k[it.id])by[it.sk].c++});
 const g=T.grades[r.id]||{};const wg=RUB.every(x=>g[x[0]]!==undefined&&g[x[0]]!=="");
 const wpts=wg?RUB.reduce((s,x)=>s+Math.min(x[2],Math.max(0,+g[x[0]]||0)),0):null;
 by.writing={c:wpts,n:WMAX,graded:wg};
 const part=p=>{let c=0,n=0;ITEMS.forEach(it=>{if(PART[it.sk]===p){n++;if(k[it.id]&&a[it.id]===k[it.id])c++}});return {c,n,pct:n?Math.round(c/n*100):0}};
 const mc=ITEMS.reduce((s,it)=>s+(k[it.id]&&a[it.id]===k[it.id]?1:0),0);
 const tot=mc+(wpts||0), max=ITEMS.length+(wg?WMAX:0);
 return {by,vocab:part("Vocabulary"),reading:part("Reading"),grammar:part("Grammar"),writing:wpts,wg,pct:max?Math.round(tot/max*100):0,tot,max};
}
const BANDS=[[0,"Pre-A2: needs foundations","b0"],[40,"A2 starting","b1"],[65,"A2 developing","b2"],[85,"A2 secure / above","b3"]];
const band=p=>{let b=BANDS[0];BANDS.forEach(x=>{if(p>=x[0])b=x});return b};
const cls=p=>p<50?"lo":p<75?"mid":"hi";
const RECO={
 vocab:["Vocabulario de viajes","Sesión 1: dedique más tiempo a las tarjetas de vocabulario, el Word storm y la Misión 1; el juego de Wordwall de la Digital Zone sirve como práctica extra."],
 main:["Idea principal","Sesión 2: modele la predicción con título e imágenes y trabaje despacio la Misión 2A (mejor título, idea principal) y la Card 1 (Main idea debate)."],
 specific:["Información específica","Sesión 2: practique el scanning en voz alta (fechas = números, nombres = mayúscula) antes de la tabla; use el time challenge sin presión al principio."],
 context:["Pistas de contexto","Sesión 2, Misión 4: modele en voz alta los tres pasos (stop, look around, guess and check) con la primera tarjeta antes de que trabajen solos."],
 sequence:["Orden de eventos","Sesión 4: refuerce las palabras de secuencia y la actividad de Sequencing; la Card 4 (Reconstruct the story) ayuda mucho aquí."],
 infer:["Inferencias","Sesión 4, Nivel 3: muestre cómo una pista del texto lleva a una conclusión y exija siempre el ¶ de evidencia."],
 grammar:["Simple Past","Sesión 3: amplíe Notice the language y la guía visual; insista en did/didn’t + verbo base y en was/were antes de la Misión 3."],
 writing:["Escritura","Sesión 5: use el plan de 6 pasos (First… Finally) como andamiaje y el checklist antes de escribir la historia."]
};
function teacherInit(){
 $("#tabs").hidden=false;
 $("#tabs").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest(".tab");if(!b)return;$$(".tab").forEach(t=>t.setAttribute("aria-selected",t===b?"true":"false"));$$(".view").forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle("on",v.id==="v-"+b.dataset.v));if(b.dataset.v==="resultados")renderResults(true)});
 S.db.collection("responses").onSnapshot(s=>{T.resp=s.docs.map(d=>({id:d.id,...d.data()}));names();renderResults()},()=>{});
 S.db.collection("grades").onSnapshot(s=>{T.grades={};s.docs.forEach(d=>T.grades[d.id]=d.data());renderResults()},()=>{});
 S.db.doc("key/main").onSnapshot(s=>{T.key=s.exists?s.data():null;T.keyLoaded=true;renderResults()},()=>{T.keyLoaded=true;renderResults()});
 if((location.hash||"").slice(1)==="resultados")$("#t-resultados").click();
}
async function names(){if(!S.user||!T.resp.length)return;try{const ps=await S.user.profiles(T.resp.map(r=>r.id));for(const id in ps)T.names[id]=ps[id]&&ps[id].name||"";renderResults()}catch(e){}}
const nm=r=>(r.profile&&r.profile.name)||T.names[r.id]||"Sin nombre";
function renderResults(force){
 const v=$("#v-resultados");if(!v||!S.isTeacher)return;
 if(T.sel){if(force)renderStudent(v);return}
 if(!force&&v.contains(document.activeElement)&&document.activeElement.matches("input,textarea,select"))return;
 const groups=[...new Set(T.resp.map(r=>(r.profile&&r.profile.group||"").trim()).filter(Boolean))].sort();
 const list=T.resp.filter(r=>!T.group||(r.profile&&r.profile.group||"").trim()===T.group).sort((a,b)=>nm(a).localeCompare(nm(b),"es"));
 const sc=list.map(r=>({r,s:scoreOf(r)}));
 const avg=f=>sc.length?Math.round(sc.reduce((a,x)=>a+f(x.s),0)/sc.length):0;
 const skillAvg=sk=>{if(sk==="writing"){const g=sc.filter(x=>x.s.wg);return g.length?Math.round(g.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.s.writing/WMAX*100,0)/g.length):null}return avg(s=>s.by[sk].n?s.by[sk].c/s.by[sk].n*100:0)};
 const pending=sc.filter(x=>!x.s.wg).length;
 const keyWarn=T.keyLoaded&&!T.key?`<div class="reco">La clave de respuestas no está cargada en los datos de la prueba, así que los puntajes salen en 0. Pídele a Claude que la vuelva a cargar.</div>`:"";
 v.innerHTML=`<div class="sheet">
  <div class="kicker">Solo visible para docentes</div>
  <h2>Resultados del diagnóstico</h2>
  ${keyWarn}
  <div class="row" style="margin:6px 0 16px"><label class="row small">Grupo: <select class="tin" id="grpSel" style="width:auto;font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:.95rem"><option value="">Todos</option>${groups.map(g=>`<option ${g===T.group?"selected":""}>${esc(g)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label><span style="flex:1"></span><button class="btn sec" type="button" id="csvBtn" ${sc.length?"":"disabled"}>${ic("down")} Exportar CSV</button></div>
  ${sc.length?`
  <div class="kpis">
   <div class="kpi"><b>${sc.length}</b><span>pruebas recibidas</span></div>
   <div class="kpi"><b>${avg(s=>s.pct)}%</b><span>promedio general</span></div>
   <div class="kpi"><b>${Math.round(sc.reduce((a,x)=>a+(x.r.minutes||0),0)/sc.length)} min</b><span>tiempo promedio</span></div>
   <div class="kpi"><b>${pending}</b><span>escrituras por calificar</span></div>
  </div>
  <h3>Desempeño por habilidad</h3>
  ${Object.keys(SKILLS).map(sk=>{const p=skillAvg(sk);return `<div class="sbar"><span>${SKILLS[sk]}${PART[sk]==="Reading"?` <span class="small muted">(reading)</span>`:""}</span><div class="tr"><i class="${p===null?"":cls(p)}" style="width:${p??0}%"></i></div><b>${p===null?"—":p+"%"}</b></div>`}).join("")}
  <h3>Distribución por nivel</h3>
  <div class="row">${BANDS.map(b=>`<span class="pill ${b[2]}">${b[1]}: ${sc.filter(x=>band(x.s.pct)===b).length}</span>`).join("")}</div>
  <h3>Qué reforzar al aplicar la cartilla</h3>
  ${(()=>{const rs=Object.keys(SKILLS).map(sk=>[sk,skillAvg(sk)]).filter(x=>x[1]!==null).sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);const weak=rs.filter(x=>x[1]<70);return (weak.length?weak:rs.slice(0,1)).map(([sk,p])=>`<div class="reco ${p>=70?"good":""}"><b>${RECO[sk][0]} · ${p}%</b><br>${RECO[sk][1]}</div>`).join("")})()}
  `:`<p class="muted">Todavía no hay pruebas enviadas${T.group?" en este grupo":""}. Cuando un estudiante pulse “Enviar mi prueba”, aparecerá aquí al instante.</p>`}
 </div>
 ${sc.length?`<div class="sheet"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Estudiantes</h3><p class="small muted">Abre un estudiante para ver sus respuestas y calificar la escritura.</p>
  <div class="tw tlist"><table><thead><tr><th>Estudiante</th><th>Código</th><th>Vocab.</th><th>Reading</th><th>Grammar</th><th>Writing</th><th>Total</th><th>Nivel</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${sc.map(({r,s})=>`<tr data-stu="${esc(r.id)}" tabindex="0"><td><b>${esc(nm(r))}</b><br><span class="small muted">${esc(r.profile&&r.profile.group||"")}</span></td><td class="small">${esc(r.profile&&r.profile.code||"—")}</td><td>${s.vocab.c}/${s.vocab.n}</td><td>${s.reading.c}/${s.reading.n}</td><td>${s.grammar.c}/${s.grammar.n}</td><td>${s.wg?s.writing+"/"+WMAX:`<span class="bad small">por calificar</span>`}</td><td><b>${s.pct}%</b></td><td><span class="pill ${band(s.pct)[2]}">${band(s.pct)[1]}</span></td></tr>`).join("")}
  </tbody></table></div></div>
 <div class="sheet"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Análisis por pregunta</h3><p class="small muted">Las preguntas con menos de 50% de aciertos aparecen en rojo: son los puntos donde más conviene detenerse.</p>
  <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Pregunta</th><th>Habilidad</th><th>Aciertos</th><th>Error más común</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${ITEMS.map((it,i)=>{const k=T.key&&T.key[it.id];const c=sc.filter(x=>k&&x.r.answers&&x.r.answers[it.id]===k).length;const p=Math.round(c/sc.length*100);const wr={};sc.forEach(x=>{const a=x.r.answers&&x.r.answers[it.id];if(a&&a!==k)wr[a]=(wr[a]||0)+1});const top=Object.entries(wr).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];return `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td class="small">${it.q?it.q.replace(/ \(¶\d\)/,""):it.stem}</td><td class="small">${SKILLS[it.sk]}</td><td class="${p<50?"bad":"ok"}">${p}%</td><td class="small">${top?`${top[0]}) ${esc(it.o[top[0].charCodeAt(0)-97])} · ${top[1]}`:"—"}</td></tr>`}).join("")}
  </tbody></table></div></div>
 <div class="sheet"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Cómo leen y aprenden (Parte 5)</h3><p class="small muted">Respuestas del grupo a las preguntas de metacognición, uso de herramientas e interacción. No se califican.</p>
  ${META.map(m=>{const cnt=m.o.map((o,j)=>sc.filter(x=>m.t==="check"?x.r.answers&&x.r.answers[m.id+"_"+j]:x.r.answers&&x.r.answers[m.id]===o).length);return `<div style="margin:14px 0"><b class="small">${m.q}</b><span class="es">${m.es}</span>${m.o.map((o,j)=>{const p=Math.round(cnt[j]/sc.length*100);return `<div class="sbar"><span class="small">${o}</span><div class="tr"><i class="hi" style="width:${p}%"></i></div><span class="small">${cnt[j]} · ${p}%</span></div>`}).join("")}</div>`}).join("")}
 </div>`:""}`;
 $("#grpSel").onchange=e=>{T.group=e.target.value;renderResults(true)};
 const cb=$("#csvBtn");if(cb)cb.onclick=()=>exportCSV(sc);
 $$("[data-stu]",v).forEach(r=>{const go=()=>{T.sel=r.dataset.stu;renderResults(true);window.scrollTo({top:0})};r.onclick=go;r.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")go()}});
}
function renderStudent(v){
 const r=T.resp.find(x=>x.id===T.sel);if(!r){T.sel=null;renderResults(true);return}
 const s=scoreOf(r),k=T.key||{},a=r.answers||{},g=T.grades[r.id]||{},p=r.profile||{};
 v.innerHTML=`<div class="sheet">
  <button class="btn sec" type="button" id="back">← Todos los resultados</button>
  <h2 style="margin-top:14px">${esc(nm(r))}</h2>
  <p class="small muted">Código: ${esc(p.code||"—")} · Programa: ${esc(p.program||"—")} · Grupo: ${esc(p.group||"—")} · Enviada: ${esc(new Date(r.sentAt).toLocaleString("es-CO"))} · ${r.minutes||"?"} min</p>
  <div class="kpis"><div class="kpi"><b>${s.vocab.c}/${s.vocab.n}</b><span>Vocabulary</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${s.reading.c}/${s.reading.n}</b><span>Reading</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${s.grammar.c}/${s.grammar.n}</b><span>Grammar</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${s.wg?s.writing+"/"+WMAX:"—"}</b><span>Writing</span></div></div>
  <p style="margin-top:12px">Total: <b>${s.pct}%</b> <span class="pill ${band(s.pct)[2]}">${band(s.pct)[1]}</span>${s.wg?"":` <span class="small muted">(sin escritura: califícala abajo)</span>`}</p>
  <h3>Lectura por subhabilidad</h3>
  ${["main","specific","context","sequence","infer"].map(sk=>{const b=s.by[sk];const pc=Math.round(b.c/b.n*100);return `<div class="sbar"><span class="small">${SKILLS[sk]}</span><div class="tr"><i class="${cls(pc)}" style="width:${pc}%"></i></div><span class="small">${b.c}/${b.n}</span></div>`}).join("")}
  <h3>Respuestas</h3>
  <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Pregunta</th><th>Respuesta</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
   ${ITEMS.map((it,i)=>{const x=a[it.id],ok=k[it.id]&&x===k[it.id];return `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td class="small">${it.q?it.q:it.stem}</td><td class="small">${x?`${x}) ${esc(it.o[x.charCodeAt(0)-97])}`:"<span class='muted'>sin responder</span>"}${!ok&&k[it.id]?`<br><span class="muted">Correcta: ${k[it.id]}) ${esc(it.o[k[it.id].charCodeAt(0)-97])}</span>`:""}</td><td class="${ok?"ok":"bad"}">${ok?"✓":"✗"}</td></tr>`}).join("")}
  </tbody></table></div>
  <h3>Escritura (${wcount(a.w)} palabras)</h3>
  <div class="box sand" style="font-family:var(--f-pen);font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--pen);white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(a.w||"(sin respuesta)")}</div>
  <div class="grid3" style="margin-top:12px">${RUB.map(x=>`<label class="fld"><span class="small">${x[1]} (0–${x[2]})</span><select class="tin" data-rub="${x[0]}"><option value="">—</option>${Array.from({length:x[2]+1},(_,i)=>`<option ${String(g[x[0]])===String(i)?"selected":""}>${i}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>`).join("")}</div>
  <label class="fld"><span class="small">Nota para ti sobre este estudiante (el estudiante no la ve)</span><textarea class="tin" id="gNote">${esc(g.note||"")}</textarea></label>
  <div class="btns"><button class="btn pri" type="button" id="gSave">${ic("check")} Guardar calificación</button><button class="btn sec" type="button" id="reset">Permitir que la presente de nuevo</button></div>
  <h3>Parte 5 · Cómo lee y aprende</h3>
  <div class="ans">${META.map(m=>{const val=m.t==="check"?m.o.filter((_,j)=>a[m.id+"_"+j]).join("; "):a[m.id];return `<div class="q">${m.q}</div><div class="a">${esc(val||"—")}</div>`}).join("")}</div>
 </div>`;
 $("#back").onclick=()=>{T.sel=null;renderResults(true)};
 $("#gSave").onclick=async e=>{const b=e.currentTarget;b.disabled=true;const body={note:$("#gNote").value.trim(),updatedAt:Date.now()};$$("[data-rub]",v).forEach(s=>{if(s.value!=="")body[s.dataset.rub]=+s.value});try{await S.db.doc("grades/"+r.id).set(body);T.grades[r.id]=body;toast("Calificación guardada.");renderResults(true)}catch(err){toast("No se pudo guardar. Intenta de nuevo.");b.disabled=false}};
 $("#reset").onclick=async()=>{if(!confirm("Se borrará la prueba enviada por "+nm(r)+" y podrá responderla otra vez. Sus respuestas en borrador se conservan. ¿Continuar?"))return;try{await S.db.doc("responses/"+r.id).delete();T.sel=null;toast("Listo: el estudiante puede presentarla de nuevo.");renderResults(true)}catch(err){toast("No se pudo reabrir la prueba.")}};
}
function exportCSV(sc){
 const q=x=>`"${String(x??"").replace(/"/g,'""')}"`;
 const head=["Nombre","Código","Programa","Grupo","Enviada","Minutos","Vocabulary /8","Reading /12","Main idea /2","Specific /4","Context /3","Sequence /1","Inference /2","Grammar /10","Writing /6","Total %","Nivel",...ITEMS.map((_,i)=>"P"+(i+1)),"Writing text",...META.map((_,i)=>"Meta"+(i+1))];
 const rows=sc.map(({r,s})=>{const a=r.answers||{},p=r.profile||{};return [nm(r),p.code,p.program,p.group,new Date(r.sentAt).toLocaleString("es-CO"),r.minutes,s.vocab.c,s.reading.c,s.by.main.c,s.by.specific.c,s.by.context.c,s.by.sequence.c,s.by.infer.c,s.grammar.c,s.wg?s.writing:"",s.pct,band(s.pct)[1],...ITEMS.map(it=>a[it.id]||""),a.w||"",...META.map(m=>m.t==="check"?m.o.filter((_,j)=>a[m.id+"_"+j]).join("; "):(a[m.id]||""))]});
 const csv="\ufeff"+[head,...rows].map(r=>r.map(q).join(",")).join("\r\n");
 if(S.dl){S.dl.save({filename:"Diagnostico_A_Memorable_Trip"+(T.group?"_"+T.group.replace(/[^\w]+/g,"_"):"")+".csv",data:new Blob([csv],{type:"text/csv"})}).catch(()=>{})}
 else toast("La descarga no está disponible en esta vista. Abre la página en su propia pestaña.");
}

/* ---------- boot ---------- */
function loadLocal(){try{const r=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(lsKey())||"null");if(r&&r.answers){S.a=r.answers;S.updatedAt=r.updatedAt||0;S.startedAt=r.startedAt||null}}catch(e){}}
async function boot(){
 renderTest();
 const setH=()=>document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--barh",$(".bar").offsetHeight+"px");setH();try{new ResizeObserver(setH).observe($(".bar"))}catch(e){window.addEventListener("resize",setH)}
 const wb=$("#wb");wb.addEventListener("input",onField);wb.addEventListener("change",onField);
 derived();
 const use=n=>(window.claude&&typeof window.claude.use==="function")?window.claude.use(n).catch(()=>null):Promise.resolve(null);
 const [user,db,dl]=await Promise.all([use("user"),use("db"),use("downloads")]);
 S.user=user;S.db=db;S.dl=dl;
 try{S.uid=user?await user.id():null}catch(e){}
 loadLocal();
 if(db&&S.uid){
  S.cloud=true;
  try{const sn=await db.doc("data/users/"+S.uid+"/diagdraft").get();if(sn.exists){const d=sn.data();if((d.updatedAt||0)>=S.updatedAt){S.a=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.answers||{}));S.updatedAt=d.updatedAt||0;S.startedAt=d.startedAt||null}}}catch(e){if(!(e&&e.code==="unavailable"))S.cloud=false}
  try{const w=await user.can("data.write");if(w===false)S.cloud=false}catch(e){}
  try{S.isTeacher=(await user.isOwner())||(await user.canEdit())}catch(e){}
  
  db.doc("responses/"+S.uid).onSnapshot(sn=>{const was=!!S.sent;S.sent=sn.exists?sn.data():null;if(S.sent&&!was)showDone(false);else if(!S.sent&&was){renderTest();applyAll()}},()=>{});
 }
 S.ready=true;$("#loading").remove();wb.disabled=false;
 if(S.sent)showDone(false);else applyAll();
 saveState(S.cloud?"ok":"local",S.cloud?"Guardado en tu cuenta":"Guardado en este navegador");
 if(S.isTeacher&&S.db)teacherInit();
}
boot();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
